Name: Dust Bunny Munny
Author: macro191
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=6][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=6][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=6][b]✨ Dust Bunny Munny: The Antique Economy[/b][/size]
[i]Turn your dusty decor into a thriving antique empire.

[b]Final Update Note
[/b]Hey everyone,
This will be my final update for this mod. I want to thank everyone who has used it—it was truly created as a fun side project, and I'm glad it resonated with some of you.
Unfortunately, I've found that some in the modding community can be a little unwelcoming to newcomers, which has diminished my enthusiasm for continuing development
That said, the mod will remain available as-is. If anyone wants to take it over or continue development, feel free to reach out.
Thanks for everything![/i][/center]

[size=4][b]🏺 What is Dust Bunny Munny?[/b][/size]
Why sell your furniture for a pittance when you can let it age like fine wine? [b]Dust Bunny Munny[/b] introduces a sophisticated furniture-aging economy to Stardew Valley. By leaving your furniture placed and untouched, it accumulates "prestige" over time, graduating through four distinct Antique Tiers. 
The longer you wait, the bigger the payout. But be careful—moving your pieces too early might cost you!

[size=4][b]🚀 New in v1.5.0: The Sparkle & Shop Update[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Visual Tiers:[/b] High-tier antiques now emit beautiful, color-coded sparkles so you can identify your most valuable pieces at a glance.
[*] [b]The Room Rewards Menu:[/b] Press [b]"L"[/b] to open an all-new interface featuring deep Stats, a specialized Shop, and a Skill Tree!
[*] [b]Refined Particle Effects:[/b] Tier 4 items now shimmer with gold radiance.
[/list]

[size=4][b]📈 Core Mechanics[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Antique Tiers (1-4):[/b] Items progress from "Gray" to "Gold" status based on time placed.
[*] [b]Set Bonuses:[/b] Earn massive multipliers by completing "Exact Item" sets or matching "Theme Tags" (e.g., Retro, Industrial, Victorian).
[*] [b]Dynamic Payouts:[/b] Rewards are influenced by the current Season, your Location (Sheds vs. Farmhouse), and even random [b]Dust Storm[/b] events!
[*] [b]Risk vs. Reward:[/b] Choose your trigger mode—get paid when you move an item, collect it, or both.
[*] [b]Dust Tokens:[/b] A unique secondary currency used in the dedicated Mod Shop.
[/list]
[size=4][b]🎨 Visual Guide: Antique Tiers[/b][/size]
[color=#808080][b] ﻿Tier 1:[/b] Gray Sparkles (Antique)[/color]
[color=#3498db][b] ﻿Tier 2:[/b] Blue Sparkles (Vintage)[/color]
[color=#9b59b6][b] ﻿Tier 3:[/b] Purple Sparkles (Boutique)[/color]
[color=#f1c40f][b] ﻿Tier 4:[/b] Gold Sparkles (Legendary Estate)[/color]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration & Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Highly compatible and configurable via [b]GMCM[/b] or [i]config.json[/i]:
[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer Support:[/b] Configure payouts to go to the Host, the Requester, or a Split between players.
[*] [b]Custom Drop Tables:[/b] Edit [i]DropTables.json[/i] to change exactly what rewards you find.
[*] [b]Theme Presets:[/b] Fully data-driven; modders can add their own theme tags to custom furniture packs.
[/list]
[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation & Controls[/b][/size]
[b]Requirements:[/b] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url] and [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[list]
[*] [b]Press L:[/b] Open Room Rewards / Stats / Shop.
[*] [b]Hover Furniture:[/b] View the Tier Badge and estimated Payout Tooltip.
[*] [b]Console Command:[/b] [code]dbm_tokens[/code] to check your balance.
[/list]
[i]Feedback and balancing notes are always welcome in the posts section! Happy decorating.[/i]
